card.name: Antibiotic misuse warning: development of resistance
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "of" in "the development of drug-resistant bacteria" and nearby words in the stock antibiotic warning about use without a proven bacterial infection. It also fires weakly on word endings and nouns before a prohibition or caution.

modes.label: Antibiotic resistance warning
modes.description: Words inside the stock sentence about prescribing without a proven or suspected bacterial infection, especially "of" after "development".
modes.example: cefixime in the absence of a proven or strongly suspected bacterial infection is unlikely to provide benefit to the patient and increases the risk of the development<< of>> drug-resistant bacteria.

modes.label: Other warning or prohibition text
modes.description: Word endings or nouns in label cautions and usage-restriction statements.
